PDF rendering of the Master List slip for [[One-Arm (V) (Errata 2)|One-Arm (V) (Errata 3)]], front face. It prints the PC-E3 game text (official text as of 27 April 2013), word for word the release-sheet text of [[One-Arm (V)]] (original). The Master List slip prints no slip number.

== References ==
[https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)], PDF page 16. Wiki copy: [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]].

Rendered at 300 dpi from the PDF and cropped to the slip (11 November 2026, Batch R8-U).
